1.q: Do guests need to install anything?
1.a: No. The invitation is a web page: guests tap the link in Telegram, Messenger or a text message and it opens in their browser.

2.q: How does each guest get their own name?
2.a: Each guest’s link carries their name and title, for example Mr Sok Dara or Lok Chumteav Sophea. The envelope and letter greet them with it, in Khmer or English.

3.q: Can we change it after sending?
3.a: Yes. Guests always see the latest version at the same link, so corrections to times, places or spelling reach everyone.

4.q: How do we see who is coming?
4.a: Each reply arrives in your Telegram with the guest’s name, how many are coming and their message. You also get a note when a guest first opens their invitation.

5.q: Can we choose our own colours and fonts?
5.a: Yes. Start from one of the styles above, then pick your colours, Khmer and English fonts, photos and music.

6.a: Yes. Add your bank KHQR codes and guests can scan them, or save them to their photos and pay from any banking app.
